milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the trapped chest at spawn-relative (6, 1, 5) inside the cobblestone building and face toward it. This rule correctly models 'the player can see the trapped chest' — max_distance=5 ensures the player is close enough (inside or at the entrance of the building), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking in the chest's direction. The target coordinates match the /setblock ~6 ~1 ~5 minecraft:trapped_chest command exactly.
